facts.fact: The Ministry of Health says data managers at the university hospital centres of the Libreville-Owendo-Akanda region were trained in June 2026 to collect, process and transmit health data through DHIS2.
The Ministry of Health calls DHIS2 the reference tool of Gabon's national health information system, used by public, private and faith-based facilities to transmit health data.

GAB.note: Nothing on consultation on a digital law or policy stated.
